chapter.verse: Ute naute aw, note in Kha Siangtho’ piak thupha thu na theih loh ding uh ka deih kei hi.
Note in Gentailte na hih lai takun, bang ci lam tawh na zuih uh ahi zongin, a pau thei lo milim omna lamah a zui mi na hih ngei uh na thei uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Pasian’ Kha Siangtho tawh, “Zeisu in hamsiatna a thuak hi,” ci-in kuamah in a gen theih loh mah bangin, “Zeisu in Topa hi,” ci-in kuamah in Kha Siangtho suang loin a pulak thei kei hi, ci-in kong theisak hi.
A hong piaksa hehpihna atuam atuam a om hangin a hong pia Kha Siangtho khat bek a om hi.
Nasepna za atuam atuam a om hangin Topa khat bek a om hi.
Nasepna atuam atuam a om hangin mi khempeuh tungah na khempeuh a bawl Pasian khat bek a om hi.
Ahi zongin a hoih a phattuam om nadingin Kha Siangtho’ kilatkhiat nading mikim tungah a pia hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua Kha Siangtho tawh mi khat kiangah pilna thu a pia hi. Tua Kha Siangtho tawh mi khat kiangah siamna thu a pia hi.
Tua Kha Siangtho tawh mi khat kiangah thu upna a pia hi. Tua Kha Siangtho tawh mi khat kiangah cina damsak theihna a pia hi.

Mi khat kiangah nalamdang bawlna thu, mi khat kiangah kamsan’na thu, mi khat kiangah lungsim kha khentel theihna thu, mi khat kiangah paunam tampi gen theihna thu, mi khat kiangah tua paute a khiatna gen theihna thute a pia hi.
Hih thu khempeuh Kha Siangtho khat bek in bawl a, ama deihna bangin mikim tungah a hawmsak hi.
Pumpi in khat bek hi-in na tampi nei a, tua pumpi khat tungah nate tampi a om napi-in pumpi khat bek a om mah bangin Khazih in ahi hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Judah mi hi taleh, Grik mi hi taleh, sila hi taleh, to nei lo hi taleh, eite khempeuh in Kha Siangtho khat bek tawh pumpi khat sungah baptaizna i ngah a, eite khempeuh in Kha Siangtho khat sung pan i dawn hi.
Pumpi in na khat bek nei loin, na tampi a nei hi.
Khe in, “Kei khut ka hih loh ciangin pum tawh ka kikum kei hi,” a cih leh, tua bang a cih ciangin kikum lo ahi kei hi.
Bil in zong, “Mittang ka hih loh ciangin pum tawh ka kikum kei hi,” a cih leh, tua bang a cih ciangin kikum lo ahi kei hi.
Pumpi khempeuh in mittang ahih leh, bang ci-a khua za ding hiam? Pumpi khempeuh in bil ahih leh, bang ci-a nam ding hiam?
Tu-in ahih leh, Pasian in a deihna bangin na atuam atuamin pumpi sungah a guang kim hi.
Tuate khempeuh in na khat ahih leh, pumpi koi-a om ding hiam?
Tu-in na tampi a om napi-in pumpi khat bek a om hi.
Mittang in khut kiangah, “Nang kong deih kei hi,” ci thei lo hi. Tua mah bangin lutang in khete kiangah, “Note kong deih kei hi,” ci thei lo hi.
Tua tham loin, a gina lo tawh a kibang nate in a kisamzaw ahi hi.
A thupi lo tawh a kibang pumpi nate minthan’na tamzaw i pia thei hi. A kilawmna nei lo nate in kilawmna tamzaw a ngah thei uh hi.
A kilawmna om nate in kilawmna a sam kei uh hi.
Pumpi sungah nate khat leh khat kikhen loin, khat leh khat a kingaihsut ciat nadingun Pasian in pumpi awhsak a, phatna a nei lo nate, phatna a piazaw hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na khat in gimna a thuak leh, na khempeuh in zong a thuak kim uh hi. Na khat in phatna a ngah leh, na khempeuh in zong lungdam khitna a ngah kim uh hi.
Note in Khazih’ pumpi na hi uh hi. Na vekpi-un a nate na hi uh hi.

Pasian in a masa belin sawltakte, a nihna thuhilhte, a thumna laihilhte, tua khit ciangin nalamdang a lak theite, tua khit ciangin cina damsak theite, huhte, pawlpi ukte, paunam tuam tampi a gen theite, pawlpi sungah a koih zo hi.
Mi a om khempeuh in sawltakte ahi uh hiam? A om khempeuh in thuhilhte ahi uh hiam? A om khempeuh in laihilhte ahi uh hiam? A om khempeuh in nalamdang bawl theite ahi uh hiam?
A om khempeuh in cina damsak theite ahi uh hiam? A om khempeuh in pautuam tampi gen theite ahi uh hiam? A om khempeuh in tua kamte a khiatna gen theite ahi uh hiam?
Note in Kha Siangtho’ piak thupha a lianbelte na deih un. Tua tham loin lam phazaw kong lak ding hi.
